Key Responsibilities Assist in collecting, cleaning, transforming, profiling, and validating structured and unstructured data. Perform exploratory data analysis to identify patterns, anomalies, trends, data quality issues, and potential features. Develop and evaluate baseline machine learning models under guidance using appropriate algorithms and metrics. Support use cases involving classification, regression, clustering, anomaly detection, forecasting, natural language processing, and Generative AI. Write reusable, readable, secure, and testable Python code aligned with team coding standards. Help convert notebooks and experiments into modular code, repeatable pipelines, APIs, or scheduled workloads. Assist with feature engineering, model comparison, hyperparameter tuning, error analysis, and experiment tracking. Support deployment of models through APIs, containers, batch jobs, or approved cloud services. Help monitor model quality, data drift, model drift, latency, failures, and operational performance. Participate in code reviews, pair programming, Agile ceremonies, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions. Document datasets, experiments, assumptions, model results, dependencies, limitations, and implementation decisions. Identify and escalate data privacy, security, compliance, responsible AI, and model-performance risks. Essential Job Functions Data Preparation and Exploration Perform data cleaning, feature preparation, validation, and exploratory analysis. Use Python libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, and Scikit-learn. Document data quality findings and support corrective actions. Model Development Build baseline machine learning models and compare performance using suitable evaluation metrics. Support feature engineering, error analysis, and hyperparameter tuning. Assist with consumption of foundation models and Large Language Models. Machine Learning Engineering Use Git for source control and collaboration. Package basic applications or models using Docker. Support APIs, pipelines, experiment tracking, and introductory MLOps practices. Testing and Monitoring Write unit tests and data validation checks. Assist in testing model behavior and production performance. Support logging, monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident documentation. Required Qualifications and Skills Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related area. 0 to 2 years of relevant experience, including internships, academic projects, research, hackathons, or personal projects. Working knowledge of Python and SQL. Understanding of statistics, probability, linear algebra, supervised learning, and unsupervised learning. Ability to communicate technical findings clearly and work effectively in a collaborative Agile environment. Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and continuous-learning abilities. Preferred Skills Exposure to Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI services, or Azure AI Foundry. Familiarity with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar frameworks. Exposure to Large Language Models, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, or retrieval-augmented generation. Familiarity with Claude Code, Codex, or similar agents, used to speed up your own development and to deliver AI-native solutions, with the judgment to review and own what they produce. Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, REST APIs, Linux, GitHub, and MLflow or similar experiment tracking. Awareness of responsible AI, privacy, explainability, and AI governance. Mandatory Pre-Joining Technology Training Selected candidates must complete the assigned role-specific learning plan, hands-on exercises, knowledge checks, and readiness assessment before joining or deployment. Python programming and object-oriented programming NumPy, Pandas, data visualization, and SQL Statistics and probability for machine learning Supervised and unsupervised machine learning Model evaluation, feature engineering, and error analysis Introduction to deep learning and natural language processing Generative AI, Large Language Models, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, and RAG Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI services, and Azure AI Foundry Git, GitHub, Linux, Docker, REST APIs, and testing fundamentals MLOps, experiment tracking, model monitoring, responsible AI, Agile, and Azure DevOps Pre-Joining Capstone Build and demonstrate an end-to-end machine learning solution covering data preparation, model development, evaluation, packaging, documentation, and basic deployment or inference. Retail & Point-of-Sale (POS) Operations · Ensure 99.99% uptime for mission-critical retail POS terminals, payment gateway integrations, inventory management databases, and merchant Wi-Fi networks within mall premises. · Coordinate with tenant IT teams and retail partners to ensure seamless network integration and compliance with centre guidelines. 5. Cybersecurity, Compliance & Data Privacy · Establish enterprise-wide cybersecurity policies, endpoint protection, Next-Gen Firewalls (NGFW), and SIEM tools. · Protect high-value intellectual property (IP), unreleased media assets, and confidential tenant/customer data in compliance with data privacy regulations (e.g., DPDP Act, PCI-DSS for retail transactions). · Conduct regular vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, and IT security audits. 6. Vendor, Project & Budget Management · Lead strategic technology implementation projects, digital upgrades, and capital expenditure (CapEx/OpEx) planning. · Manage relationships with global technology vendors, telecom operators, OEM partners, and service providers. · Negotiate Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs), software licensing, and hardware procurement to optimize costs without compromising quality. 7. Leadership & Cross-Functional Team Management · Lead, mentor, and upskill a multi-disciplinary team of IT engineers, system administrators, and helpdesk support staff. · Define and monitor strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for incident resolution and system performance. · Act as a technology advisor to executive leadership, bridging the gap between creative teams, retail management, and technical execution. Core Enterprise & Network Infrastructure · Advanced administration of Windows Server, Linux, and macOS enterprise environments. · Enterprise networking: Cisco/Aruba L2/L3 switching, VLAN segmentation, SD-WAN, enterprise firewalls, and QoS configuration. · Virtualization & Cloud: VMware ESXi, Hyper-V, AWS, Azure, and hybrid cloud integration. · Active Directory, LDAP, SSO, and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) frameworks. · Advanced backup frameworks (Veeam, Commvault) and Disaster Recovery architecture. Domain-Specific Expertise · Retail & Mall Tech: POS infrastructure, payment gateway security (PCI-DSS), digital signage networks, and smart building integration (BMS/CCTV). · Theater/Exhibition Tech: Theatre Management Systems (TMS), digital projection networks, and ticketing system integration. · Media / Post-Production: High-speed SAN/NAS (Avid ISIS/Nexus, Isilon, QNAP), render management (Deadline, OpenCue), and MAM workflows. Educational Qualifications & Credentials · Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Electronics, or a related technical field. Master’s degree / MBA is a plus.
